description: This file manages user notices and backup scheduling for the Notesnook project, including functions for scheduling backups, determining when to show notices, and handling backup actions.

methods.name: scheduleBackups
methods.description: Schedules automatic backups based on user configuration, using cron expressions.

methods.name: scheduleFullBackups
methods.description: Schedules automatic full backups based on user configuration, using cron expressions.

methods.name: shouldAddAutoBackupsDisabledNotice
methods.description: Checks if the auto backups disabled notice should be added.

methods.name: shouldAddBackupNotice
methods.description: Determines if a backup reminder notice should be shown based on last backup time and user settings.

methods.name: shouldAddRecoveryKeyBackupNotice
methods.description: Checks if a recovery key backup reminder should be shown.

methods.name: shouldAddLoginNotice
methods.description: Checks if a login reminder notice should be shown.

methods.name: shouldAddConfirmEmailNotice
methods.description: Checks if an email confirmation reminder should be shown.

methods.name: resetNotices
methods.description: Resets and sets notices based on current conditions and user status.

methods.name: saveBackup
methods.description: Handles backup creation and user notification, with different behavior for desktop and web environments.
